headline: 2004 executive order aimed at expanding economic and business opportunities for Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President George W. Bush, directs the federal government to work on increasing economic opportunity for Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders. It focuses on helping them take part more fully in business, likely including federal programs and contracting. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and programs involved cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Asian American and Pacific Islander business owners
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to increase their participation in business and economic opportunities, possibly including federal programs.
Agencies are likely directed to take steps that support economic opportunity for Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders, though the exact duties are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 13, 2004; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
